cves.description: A C-based Linux security utility for detecting, safely verifying (Proof of Concept), and mitigating CVE-2026-64600 (RefluXFS). It provides kernel vulnerability assessment, XFS reflink detection, a safe race-condition PoC, and layered mitigation using SystemTap and XFS hardening.
